notes: Patient-level bootstrap bands (invariant 5) for the same run.
name: decomposition_lee_smc_bands
cohort: GSE132465 (Lee SMC), 10 matched patients of 23; 13 excluded for lacking a matched normal+tumour pair.
labeller: src.reference.labels.assign_labels (the ONE labeller after decision #13 / issue #44). depth_quantile=0.10, W1's committed value; 708 of 7,080 epithelial cells unresolved_depth.
target_genes: panel tiers A+B+C+D. Tier E is excluded because MUC2 and TFF3 are opposite_lineage markers and open decision #1's narrow reading scopes the target set to THIS run.

QUOTABILITY.lineage: DO NOT QUOTE. Still depth-confounded at the committed floor (|rho| 0.31, arms 2.36x).
QUOTABILITY.crypt_position: DO NOT QUOTE. Same confound, and numerically identical to lineage on this cohort (issue #42).
QUOTABILITY.best4: Clean of the confound (|rho| 0.055) but the intrinsic term is not_estimable for EVERY patient — 55 best4 cells cohort-wide. G4's finding, reproduced on Lee.
QUOTABILITY.epithelial: Clean, and the only rung with a quotable intrinsic term. Its compositional term is EXACTLY ZERO by construction — the whole epithelium is one bin, so the mature fraction is 1.0 in both arms. That zero is a denominator choice, not a finding.

g2: FAILS as pre-registered. Tier A (GUCA2A) was expected compositional and its intrinsic term is 4.4x larger; tier B (MLH1) was expected intrinsic and shows essentially nothing; tier D (MS4A12) was expected neither and carries a small intrinsic term whose CI excludes zero. The panel.yaml falsification rule is not literally tripped — A, B and D do not all return the SAME answer — but they do not separate as specified.
invariant_1: not_estimable rows carry intrinsic=None, never 0.0. 540 of 2160 rows at the best4 rung.
invariant_7: interaction is a separate column and is never folded.
